title: Artists and Musicians From Around the World
subject: arts

sections.body: Frida Kahlo (Mexico) painted bold self-portraits full of colour and Mexican culture.
Katsushika Hokusai (Japan) made 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa', a famous woodblock print.
A. R. Rahman (India) composes film music heard around the world. Fela Kuti (Nigeria) created Afrobeat music.
Art and music often show where the artist comes from: their landscape, stories and traditions.
